verdict.rationale: Jan exposes an OpenAI-compatible local API server at localhost:1337 which could be called from Python/JS via standard OpenAI SDKs, but there is no evidence of official Jan-branded client libraries in Python or JavaScript, no SDK docs, and probes for openapi/llms.txt endpoints returned 404s. missing for 10: official Python/JS client libraries, SDK documentation, published API reference/OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation of SDK usage.
